title: Freekeh Maqluba with Eggplant and Tomatoes
subtitle: layered and turned out
description: A layered pot of roasted potato, eggplant, tomato and spiced freekeh, cooked in baharat water and flipped onto a serving plate.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C and line 3 trays with baking paper.
Arrange the potato slices, eggplant slices and tomato halves on the trays, preferably separately. Brush with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Bake for about 30 minutes until golden. The tomatoes can come out a few minutes earlier.
Meanwhile, fry the chopped onions in a pan with a little oil until golden. Add the freekeh and stir for 1 to 2 minutes.

Arrange the potato slices on the bottom of a 28 cm pot and scatter over about a third of the freekeh. Layer the eggplant and more freekeh and finish with the tomatoes, keeping 4 tomato halves for serving.

Season the boiling water with the baharat, salt and pepper and carefully pour it over the dish. You can place a plate on top of the contents so the water does not disturb the layers. Bring to the boil, reduce the heat to the lowest setting, cover and cook for 45 minutes. If the freekeh is still hard, add another 1/4 cup of boiling water and cook for another 10 minutes.
Turn out onto a serving plate, scatter with parsley, add the reserved tomatoes and serve.
